library(tidyverse)
setwd ("/Users/cmdb/qb25-answers/week_1/")
header <- c( "chr", "start", "end", "count" )
df_kc <- read_tsv( "hg19-kc-count.bed", col_names=header )

ggplot(data = df_kc, aes(x=start, y=count, color = chr)) +
  geom_line() +
  labs(
    x = "Start" , 
    y = "Count" , 
    title = "Gene density across main chromosomes"
    ) +
  facet_wrap(. ~ chr, scales = "free")

ggsave( "exercise1.png" )
